seo_title: Terra Luz | Private Pool, Spa & Three King Beds in Indio
seo_description: A private saltwater pool, heated spa, and three king bedrooms in Indio. Bring your partner or friends; kids and dogs are welcome, too. Sleeps eight.
tagline: Your own pool. A king bed in every room.
description_heading: Pool days, patio dinners, and three king beds.
description_p1: Spend your days by the private saltwater pool and evenings under the stars in our terracotta courtyard. Terra Luz has room for a couples’ getaway or a trip with friends.
description_p2: Each of the three bedrooms has its own personality, a king bed, and organic cotton sheets. Two also have twin trundles. Sleeps up to eight.
description_p3: There’s a full kitchen, built-in BBQ, and laundry. Bringing kids? A pack ’n play, Stokke high chair, baby bath, books, and toys are already here.
description_p4: Spa heating is included. Pool heating is $75/day with a two-day minimum, or $400/week, with at least 24 hours’ notice. Dogs are welcome with a pet fee.
